Player Interests

Player Interests — Shattered Sea

Content Priority Queue

  1. Grung bombing plot / Jean-Claude’s Simone connection — highest engagement from JC’s player, personal stakes, active deadline
  2. Umberlee / Pearl of Souls — Delmar’s player drove the entire confession and shrine scene with long-form RP
  3. Kyzil / pilgrimage thread — Crissdalynn’s player eager for martial identity content; spar was a highlight
  4. Festival (Il Gioco delle Beffe) — party signed up; provides tonal relief and cover for the Grung plot
  5. Perrin’s abyss / patron thread — quieter this session but still active; the “Grow” thread hasn’t advanced

Per-Player Tracking

Kaden — Perrin Black-Jaw

  • Engaged with: supporting the party tactically (healing, inspiration, scouting), Nona/Passage relationship, species-aware social dynamics (avoided bringing owl to Rattkin venue), comic relief
  • Cold to: nothing clearly cold yet; Perrin’s own threads (abyss vision, patron) didn’t advance this session but the player didn’t resist them
  • Notes: Perrin’s player shows restraint and emotional intelligence — the “I know your pain” moment with Delmar was deliberately understated. Plays support in both combat and RP. Watch for his threads falling behind as JC and Delmar dominate.

Sam — Delmar Fisk

  • Engaged with: backstory vulnerability (confession scene was entirely player-driven monologue), negotiating with Umberlee (stood his ground against a god), slice-of-life tavern RP, tactical combat (sneak attack through bardic inspiration was a peak moment)
  • Cold to: nothing observed
  • Notes: Delmar’s player drives social scenes and character vulnerability. Session 04 was his strongest RP session — the confession, the Umberlee negotiation, and the Crissdalynn reaction. Now abstaining from alcohol in-character. High investment in the Pearl plotline. “I see why you guys like rogues” — discovering combat identity.

Jean-Claude’s Player

  • Engaged with: gear acquisition and optimization (drove shopping for 12+ minutes), the Grung investigation as a personal-stakes mission, tactical precision in the sewers, complex emotions around executing the purple Grung, the defector revelation (genuinely surprised), Kyzil tension (the “no threat” dismissal landed)
  • Cold to: nothing observed — this player engages with everything
  • Notes: Jean-Claude’s player took full investigative lead on the Grung plot — directing marching order, reading signs, testing witnesses with physical evidence. The execution scene showed genuine character conflict between Grung identity and opposition to Simone. The defector concept opens a new personal arc. Festival joke: “I can poison someone and then go, ha ha ha.”

Crissdalynn’s Player

  • Engaged with: martial identity (eager for spar, spun staff when challenged), master-apprentice dynamic with Kyzil, combat dominance (the kingfisher dive was a table-wide celebration moment), protective instinct toward Delmar (leg sweep for going to Umberlee alone)
  • Cold to: nothing clearly cold; quieter in investigation/social scenes
  • Notes: Crissdalynn’s player peaks in physical moments — the grapple, the kingfisher dive, the leg sweep. DM acknowledged “this fucking character.” Perrin’s player compared her to Goku. Combat is her spotlight; investigation is JC’s.

Recent Signals

Session 04

  • JC drove shopping + Grung investigation. Highest sustained engagement across two distinct activity types. The Grung plot is personal-stakes content and it shows.
  • Delmar drove confession + Umberlee negotiation. Two of the session’s biggest RP scenes were entirely Delmar-initiated. The abstinence flag is new character texture.
  • Crissdalynn dominated combat. Grappled Kyzil (nat 1), kingfishered the purple Grung at 45ft fly speed. “Peak moments” player — design combat that gives her one signature move per fight.
  • Perrin played support + comic relief. Bardic inspiration was the session’s mechanical MVP. Healing kept the party alive through the spar. The taunting (“you’ll have to catch me, see?”) is his combat voice.
  • Kyzil/JC tension is real. The “no threat” comment and dagger pin bothered JC’s player at the character level. This is an interpersonal thread worth developing.
  • Boots of flying retcon — Perrin’s “I have little rat feet and I need to feel the ground” was a character-first mechanical decision. Players are prioritizing character identity over optimization.

Session 03

  • Perrin/abyss vision was high engagement — Kaden leaned in hard
  • Delmar’s water moment flagged but brief
  • Crissdalynn/Kyzil reunion was emotional peak
  • Nona meeting was strong for Perrin’s player
